independent_verification.source_claim: Read Eq4-5 physical p3, actually viewed Eq10-13 and Figure3 p4, Eq17 p5, theoretical-guarantees statement p8 and AlgorithmS1 p12. S is explicitly l1, and Eq11 explicitly assumes a Lipschitz-continuous gradient.
independent_verification.assumptions_verified: Scalar restriction |r| is nondifferentiable at0 and derivative differences across +/-epsilon have ratio1/epsilon. Zero initialization permits zero residual; no explicit smooth replacement is defined. For the separate quadratic normal-equation check, freeze w=1, tilde masks=.1, previousmask=.2, Rprev=.1, gradient1, C1,B0,mu1,alpha2,L10. Eq5 is compatible with those prior masks; both proposed updates lie in[0,1].
independent_verification.counterevidence: The learned network may still perform well; a smooth or nonsmooth proximal scheme can define a different valid method. Even granting Eq12 as an independently chosen surrogate, its derivative coefficient is C^2+mu+alpha*Ls*w^2, so the omitted alpha cannot be absorbed only in the denominator while retained in the numerator. Eq17 background scalar minimizer independently passes.
independent_verification.core_dependency: Explicit strict mathematical objective-to-network derivation and theoretical guarantees, not merely a notation preference.
